---
title: "About"
---

**GNSS Research Notes** is a technical publication associated with IP-Solutions Satellite Applications Inc.

Its purpose is to publish engineering notes, measurements, tutorials, implementation observations, research-related material, and practical discussions in GNSS and PNT.

## Editorial approach

The publication is intentionally separate in tone from the main corporate website. Articles should primarily be useful technical material rather than sales copy. IP-Solutions products, measurements, software, or test equipment may be referenced when they are relevant to the subject.

## Authorship

Authorship is selected article by article.

- **IP-Solutions Research Team** is the default collective byline.
- Individual researchers or engineers may use their real names when appropriate.
- Guest or joint authors may be credited where relevant.
- AI systems are not presented as human authors. When material AI assistance is worth disclosing, it can be stated in an editorial note.

The publication may evolve to include additional contributors and editorial identities, but bylines should remain truthful about responsibility for the technical content.
